newsitem.title: BOSNIA: NATO confirms arrest action in Bosnia.
newsitem.headline: NATO confirms arrest action in Bosnia.

text.p: NATO launched an operation on Thursday to arrest at least one indicted war criminal in the northwest town of Prijedor in Bosnian Serb-controlled territory, an alliance source said.
An officer in the NATO-led peace force told Reuters that an operation was under way but would not identify the suspect or suspects who were targetted.
The NATO officer, who asked not to be named, confirmed an account from a Bosnian government source that the Stabilisation Force (SFOR) had begun an arrest action on Thursday morning.
The report coincided with a tense power struggle in Bosnia's Serb republic between President Biljana Plavsic and hardliners loyal to ex-president and indicted war criminal Radovan Karadzic.
A Western official said the operation did not necessarily focus on Karadzic or Bosnian Serb army commander Ratko Mladic, the two most prominent suspects charged by the U.N. war crimes tribunal.
Tribunal investigators assisted by U.N. soldiers last month arrested the former Serb mayor of Vukovar in Croatia on a sealed indictment.
